title: ‘Other Mommy,’ ‘Whalefall’ and ‘Victorian Psycho’:  The Authors Behind the Page-to-Screen Nightmares Compare Notes
summary: Ahead of their film adaptations releasing this fall, authors Josh Malerman, Daniel Kraus and Virginia Feito discuss their starry casts, why none of them writes with Hollywood in mind and their early adaptation buzz from a Cannes premiere to a viral trailer.
